॥ Om, and also from the context of Om. ॥ 1/2/10 ॥

Just as in the case of the creation of the universe, so too from the context of that (Om). “In the beginning, there was nothing; there was no death, and Hari was not present. Then, with His mind, the Self (Atman) created water. Janardana, lying down in that water, the Lord created a great egg. In that egg, the Lord created Brahma, named Samvatsara. He opened His mouth and swallowed him. Then, out of compassion, Vishnu engaged him in the act of creation. And the all-pervading Lord created the entire universe for Hari.” Thus it is stated in the Brahma Vaivarta Purana. ॥ 10 ॥
